title: Coverage round snap-financial CF-1, CF-2: CO-115's father also receives crime victim compensation, AmeriCorps payments and rent from land he does not manage
comment: The household of CO-115 (p1, 34, earning $1,000 a month, and his daughter p2, 6, in a shelter; applied 2026-11-02;
evaluated 2027-02-10), except that p1 also receives each month $500 of crime victim compensation and $300 of AmeriCorps
payments (other_unearned_income_nontaxable 800) and $1,000 of rent from land he owns and does not manage, with $600 of costs
(other_unearned_income_taxable 1,000), all verified. Before the coverage round SNAP counted all $1,800 (CF-1, CF-2).
Only SNAP is asserted.
expect_comment: SNAP, February 2027, household of 2 (FY2027 figures):
unearned income = 800 + 1,000 - 800 excluded (crime victim compensation, 4.405.2.A.27; AmeriCorps, A.4)
gross income = 1,000 wages + 400 = 1,400; earned income deduction = 0.20 x 1,000 = 200; standard deduction 217
child support and dependent care unverified after 2026-12-02, so 0 (as in CO-115); no medical or shelter deduction
net income = 1,400 - 200 - 217 = 983; benefit reduction = ceil(0.3 x 983) = ceil(294.9) = 295
allotment = 562 - 295 = 267 (before the round: unearned 1,800, gross 2,800, over the gross income limit)

title: Coverage round snap-financial CF-3: CO-115's father is paid $250 every week; a month with five paydays and a month with four both count 4.3 weeks
comment: The household of CO-115, except that p1's employer pays him $250 every Friday (wages_pay_frequency weekly,
wages_gross_per_pay_period 250): January 2027 holds five Fridays ($1,250 received) and February four ($1,000).
10 CCR 2506-1 4.402.A.2 (S3112) converts weekly pay at 4.3 (snap_person_wages, CO-4324). Only SNAP is asserted.
expect_comment: SNAP, January and February 2027, household of 2 (FY2027 figures):
wages = 4.3 x 250 = 1,075 in each month (not 1,250 in January or 1,000 in February)
earned income deduction = 0.20 x 1,075 = 215; standard deduction 217; child support and dependent care unverified, 0
net income = 1,075 - 215 - 217 = 643; benefit reduction = ceil(0.3 x 643) = ceil(192.9) = 193
allotment = 562 - 193 = 369 (before the round: January 1,250 gross, 783 net, 327; February as CO-115, 387)

title: Coverage round snap-financial CF-4: CO-83's stepfather has no income and pays $300 of court-ordered child support for a child elsewhere
comment: The household of CO-83 (a mother earning $1,500, her daughter and the mother's husband, who has no income;
applied 2026-10-12), except that the husband p1 pays $300 a month of court-ordered child support for a child who
lives elsewhere, verified. 10 CCR 2506-1 4.407.5.A (S99) excludes it from the household's total countable gross
income; before the coverage round it came off p1's own income (0) and was lost. Only SNAP is asserted.
expect_comment: SNAP, household of 3 (FY2027 figures): gross = 1,500 (p2's wages) - 300 child support exclusion (CO-4333) = 1,200
earned income deduction = 0.20 x 1,500 = 300; standard deduction (size 3) 217; 1,200 - 300 - 217 = 683
full month allotment = 808 - 0 = 808 (before the round: gross 1,500, net 214, 743)
October (initial month, applied on the 12th): 808 x 20 / 31 = 521.29, rounded down to 521 (before: 479)

title: Coverage round snap-financial CF-9: CO-115's father is on strike, and the household was not eligible the day before the strike
comment: The household of CO-115, except that p1 is a striking member (snap_is_striker; is_participating_in_strike), his
pre-strike income was the same $1,000, and the household was not eligible the day before the strike. 7 CFR 273.1(e)
makes the household ineligible; 10 CCR 2506-1 4.207.3.A (S3122) determines the allotment only after eligibility is
established, so it has none. Only SNAP is asserted.
expect_comment: SNAP, February 2027: the full month computation is CO-115's (gross 1,000, net 583, 562 - 175 = 387), but the household
is not eligible (striking_member), so the allotment is 0 (before the round: 387 was issued, CF-9)

title: Coverage round snap-financial CF-5: a high school student who turns 18 on February 5 earns $400 a month; excluded through February, counted from March
comment: The household of CO-115, except that the daughter p2 was born 2009-02-05, turns 18 on 2027-02-05 and is a high school
student (education_program_type secondary), earning $400 a month in wages with no pay stubs. 10 CCR 2506-1 4.405.C
(S3101) excludes her earnings until the month following the month she turns 18 (snap_student_earnings_are_excluded,
CO-2569, read per month). Evaluated 2027-02-10, after the birthday. Only SNAP is asserted.
expect_comment: SNAP, household of 2 (FY2027 figures):
February 2027: p2's $400 is excluded (she turned 18 in the month): gross 1,000, net 583, allotment 387 as CO-115;
her excluded wages need no verification (CF-10), so 2 items are pending, as in CO-115
March 2027: counted: gross 1,400; earned income deduction 0.20 x 1,400 = 280; standard deduction 217;
net = 1,400 - 280 - 217 = 903; benefit reduction = ceil(270.9) = 271; allotment = 562 - 271 = 291;
her wages are now verified and no document was received, so 3 items are pending
(before the round, evaluated after the birthday, February counted the $400 too: gross 1,400, allotment 291)
